parameters.content:
## Sync saved delivery status to the original queue

This companion is separate from published template #21159. It reads current Prooftask jobs and updates existing Sheet rows, including jobs already notified. It never submits, accepts, signs or pays.

1. Read n8n/DELIVERY_LOOP.md and add every review_* column listed there.
2. Set the same spreadsheetId and numeric sheetId in Configuration.
3. Use the same Google Sheets credential on both Sheet nodes.
4. On the HTTP node, select Header Auth for the original Agent grant that created these jobs.
5. Run manually, one execution per queue at a time. Keep request_id and job_id unchanged.

A failed or mismatched read writes UNKNOWN, never an acceptance. Status observations may change after corrections or concerns. This example has no schedule, webhook receiver or notification.
